instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. In a minimalist white studio, three friends sit huddled on the floor. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a white high-neck top looks forward with a gentle smile. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1) in a white shirt rests with her eyes closed. They embrace affectionately in a tight group hug. The scene is illuminated by soft, bright studio lighting.
